en: Elena, congratulations for the first time
into the semi -final of the US Open,
and on Monday,
when the new ranking comes out, you
will be officially the new world number one
in women's tennis.
What does it all mean to you, Elena?
It's tough to find words.
It's been very difficult match, and honestly,
a lot of nerves, of course, and yeah,
it wasn't maybe the highest level,
but I'm glad that I pushed
through, and thank you so much guys
for coming, supporting.
It's been an early match. In my head,
I was complaining a little bit about the sun,
shadow, a lot of things.
It was definitely a battle inside me,
but I'm glad that I pushed all
the negative thoughts away,
and I kept on fighting, and yeah, again,
super happy to be in the semi -final here.
Not only in the semis, but also
on the world number one on Monday.
Do you think about it
when you are playing the match?
You came back from a set down,
you saved break points in the third set.
What kept you going in these moments,
and what kept you so strong
in these important moments?
Yeah, as I said, I didn't start that well,
and I was too much negative,
and also it wasn't easy
because all the matches here I played
at night, and I was scheduled
to play once in the morning,
but then it was raining, so basically it's
been the first match like this on the sun,
so yeah, it was a lot of unforced errors,
but then I just was telling myself,
keep on fighting, keep on working
on some things, and yeah, luckily,
it went my way, and I'm just super happy.
You played so well, I will let you go soon.
Now, milestone is achieved,
you are world number one.
How will you try and stay focused?
There are two more matches to be played.
What will be your mental approach
in the next two days, hopefully, for you?
Well, it's just a number right now,
and of course, I'm in the semi,
so my goal is to win the tournaments
which I play, and I go just match at a time,
and it's an amazing achievement,
but you know how quick everything
can change in tennis, ranking wise,
during the match, so I feel like I just need
to focus on my game, try to recover,
and enjoy tomorrow.
Congratulations, Elena, into the semi -finals,
Elena Rybakina.
